summary: kubernetes.core helm and helm_info deprecate status.values (removal after 2027-01-08) in favor of status.release_values.
questions: What replaces status.values in kubernetes.core.helm results?

answer_card.title: helm status.values deprecated
answer_card.answer_md: In `kubernetes.core.helm` and `helm_info`, the `status.values` return value is deprecated and removed after **2027-01-08**. Use **`status.release_values`** instead.
